title: Chaperone-mediated autophagy in the regulation of the circadian clock
projectDescription: Oscillatory lysosomal activity for disposal of the components of the cellular clock is essential to sustain organismal circadian rhythms
sampleProcessingProtocol: Solubilization of purified lysosomes in 5% SDS/50mM TEAB. Trypsin digestion using solid phase columns(s-TRAP). RP-HPLC MS/MS analysis in Qexactive-HFX
dataProcessingProtocol: Raw files were processed with MaxQuant (v 1.6.7.0) using the standard settings against a mouse protein database (UniProtKB/TrEMBL, 53449 sequences)
